verdicts.reason: Both crop the woman/mug/gift photo down to an unrecognisable sliver of sweater on the right edge, so the key imagery is lost, and white text (the headline, 'with your next cup of coffee') sits on top of the busy red knit pattern. In both, the stars and the URL are aligned on a different axis from the centred copy. A at least keeps 'GET A GIFT' as the dominant element. B shrinks the headline below the size of the supporting line 'with your next cup of coffee', which inverts the hierarchy. B also jams the headline right under the gift icons and leaves large uneven gaps further down.
